defs.def: arranged neatly and with everything in order 整洁的；整齐的；井然有序的；井井有条的

ex.s: Involve your child in the daily running of the house: tidying toys, feeding the dog, watering the plants. ____36____ When the tasks become as routine as brushing teeth, kids internalise that helping with housework is simply part of life.
ex.t: 让孩子参与家庭的日常运转：收拾玩具、喂狗、给植物浇水。____ 当这些任务变得像刷牙一样习以为常，孩子就会内化这样一种观念：帮忙做家务本来就是生活的一部分。

ex.s: I also water the flowers in the yard and tidying up my own bedroom whatever necessary.
ex.t: 首先做家务有助于我们成为一个负责任的人。

ex.s: Sunday 20 October I was tidying my room yesterday and found an old photo in a notebook.
ex.t: 10月20日 星期日　我昨天在整理房间时，在一本笔记本里发现了一张旧照片。

ex.s: Meg went to tidy the living room, hiding the litter under the sofa and shutting the curtains to save her the trouble of dusting.
ex.t: 梅格去收拾客厅，把垃圾藏到沙发底下，并拉上窗帘，省得她还要费力除尘。

ex.s: They were then busy for the whole afternoon, tidying and cleaning, as well as receiving guests and running errands.
ex.t: 于是他们整个下午都忙个不停，收拾打扫，还要接待客人、跑腿办事。

defs.def: keeping things neat and in order 爱整洁的；爱整齐的

ex.s: Jim says we ______ stay in his house as long as we leave it clean and tidy. （    ）
ex.t: 例：站在那边______你就能看得更清楚。

ex.s: For example, most city parks are kept neat and tidy so that humans will find them beautiful.
ex.t: 例如，大多数城市公园都保持得整洁干净，好让人们觉得它们美观。

defs.def: a tidy amount of money is fairly large 高额的；可观的
